---
title: SciCloud
---

> Typical tasks: Data gathering, Hosting Web Applications, Running Server Applications (Data Transformation, Data Analysis).

[SciCloud](/tools/scicloud/index.qmd) is a VU-hosted platform where researchers can host virtual servers or desktops for their research applications.

::: {.description}

Unlike Research Cloud, SciCloud uses a [low fixed price per month](/tools/scicloud/cost_access.qmd), which makes it a cheap option to run applications and websites 24/7.

IT for Research will give you a machine with the basic OS installed. You are responsible for installing applications yourself, although ITvO will usually help you to get started.

:::
